display_long_description:
RETTERVR is a virtual reality training solution for fire departments and emergency services. The application enables realistic training of operational scenarios – especially in the field of technical rescue – within an immersive and controlled environment.
Users train typical incident situations such as traffic accidents, assess scenes, carry out measures, and make decisions under time pressure. In addition to technical procedures, communication and team coordination are a key focus.
The scenarios follow a structured didactic approach and can be flexibly integrated into training and exercises. Variable parameters and scenario variations ensure repeatable yet diverse training experiences.
RETTERVR supports instructors in presenting complex situations without high logistical effort or risks associated with live training. At the same time, it provides participants with a safe way to gain experience and build operational confidence.
Suitable for training, advanced education, and independent practice in emergency response and rescue services.
